::: {#sol-expression-or-algorithm-part4}

Precedence resolves how the symbols group:
$a x^2 + b x + c$ parses as a sum of three products, with the power applied first,
and that parse is a [tree](#def-parse-tree).
Precedence is a rule for reading the [expression](#def-expression), not a step in an [algorithm](#def-algorithm) that evaluates it.

:::
